description.value: Cape Scott Water Taxi / North Coast Trail Shuttle runs pre-booked water taxi trips from Port Hardy to North Coast Trail access points (Shushartie Bay, Cape Sutil, Fisherman's Bay) and a land van shuttle from Cape Scott parking lot back to Port Hardy; seasonal April–September only, no stated bicycle policy.
